layout.title: Service level objectives
layout.subtitle: Track availability targets and error budgets

list.emptyHint: An objective turns "is it up?" into "is it up enough?" — set a target and watch the error budget.
list.quotaReached: Objective limit reached for this plan.

detail.burndownHelp: Remaining budget over the current window, against the pace that would spend it exactly.
detail.burndownEmpty: The window has only just started — no points yet.

alerting.title: Alerting
alerting.subtitle: Page on-call when the error budget is burning too fast. Both windows must exceed the threshold, so a spike that already ended does not page.
alerting.toggleFailed: Failed to update the alert policy
alerting.inconclusive: Not enough data to judge: {{long}} and {{short}} probes in the two windows, {{min}} required. An inconclusive window never fires.
alerting.resolving: Both windows are below the threshold — the alert resolves once that has held for a full short window.
alerting.saveFailed: Failed to update the alert policy
alerting.formSubtitle: Tune when this policy pages. Both windows must exceed the threshold to fire.
alerting.enableHelp: Alerting is opt-in. A disabled policy is never evaluated.
alerting.longWindowHelp: Proves the burn is significant. Capped at 7 days.
alerting.shortWindowHelp: Proves it is still happening. Must be shorter than the long window.
alerting.windowsInvalid: The short window must be greater than 0 and no longer than the long window (max 7 days).
alerting.thresholdHelp: Burn-rate multiple. 1x spends the month's budget exactly by month end.
alerting.minSamplesHelp: A window with fewer probes than this is inconclusive and never fires.
alerting.severityHelp: Carried into the incident title and every notification. Channel routing still comes from the escalation policy.

form.name: Name
form.slugHelp: URL-safe identifier, generated from the name when left empty
form.scopeHelp: Exactly one check or one check group
form.timezoneHelp: Calendar months are resolved in this IANA zone
form.excludeMaintenanceHelp: Probes recorded during an active maintenance window do not consume error budget. Only applies from the day tagging started — earlier months are unaffected.

delete.title: Delete this objective?
delete.description: The objective {{name}} will be removed. Historical results are untouched — only the objective goes away.

reports.title: Uptime reports
reports.subtitle: Email a recurring availability digest
reports.emptyHint: A monthly digest reaches the people who never open the dashboard.
reports.testSent: Test report queued to your address
reports.testFailed: Failed to send the test report
reports.testSuppressed: You have unsubscribed this address and cannot receive a test send

form.name: Name
form.timezoneHelp: The period closes at midnight in this IANA zone
form.recipientsHelp: Email addresses that receive the digest. Anyone who unsubscribes is removed from this list automatically.
form.scopeHelp: Leave both empty to report on every check in the organization
form.includeSlosHelp: Add an error-budget summary for every objective in scope
form.saveFailed: Failed to save the report schedule

delete.title: Delete this report?
delete.description: The schedule {{name}} will stop sending. Recipients are not notified.
delete.failed: Failed to delete the report schedule
